select A.id as id, A.real_name as realName,A.user_id as userId, A.social_security_company_id as socialSecurityCompanyId,A.staff_state as staffState, A.organ_id as organId, A.department_id as departmentId, A.team_id as teamId, A.entry_time as entryTime, A.quit_time as quitTime, GROUP_CONCAT(ifnull(A.social_security_company_id,''),'_',ifnull(A.organ_id,''),'_',ifnull(A.department_id,''),'_',ifnull(A.team_id,'')) as contidion from ( SELECT a.id,a.real_name,a.user_id,a.social_security_company_id,a.organ_id,a.department_id,a.team_id,a.entry_time,a.quit_time,a.staff_state from staff_personnel_info a ) A group by A.id

mapper.update: update staff_personnel_info s left JOIN (select staff_personnel_id from staff_pay_personnel_slip where staff_pay_slip_id = #{staffPaySlipId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) a on s.id = a.staff_personnel_id set staff_state = 6 where s.staff_state =3 and a.staff_personnel_id is not null and s.relation = 5;
